acceptance_criteria.criterion: All new TypeScript interfaces compile without errors under strict: true
ClassRangeRequest, RangeMetric, ShipMetricSummary, and ClassRangeResponse interfaces match their backend DTO counterparts
ShipDetails interface includes engineCount and cargoType
EnginePerformance interface includes top speed fields and engine count
PhysicsResponse interface includes absolute metric fields
classRangeApi.calculate() correctly calls POST /calculate/class-range and returns typed response
useClassRange hook provides result, loading, error state and calculate/reset methods
Class-range API calls are debounced at 500ms
